core.title: Extra Long 7 Inch Kickdown Door Stop, Deltana DHK5-EXT2
tags: DEL-DHK5-EXT2 Extra Long 7 Inch Kickdown Door Holders

text.description_html:
Deltana DHK5-EXT2, Extra Long 7" Kickdown Door Holder

The 7" Kickdown Door Stop mounts to the lower surface of the door to keep it in an open position. When not in use, it flips up and out of the way. This extra long kickdown door holder is made of solid brass by Deltana. It includes a non-skid easily replaceable rubber tip to protect the floor and is supplied with mounting screws. The main kickdown door stop is a Deltana DHK5. A custom made 2" long brass extension is added for the extra length.

Also Available: 4 Inch Kickdown, 5 Inch Kickdown and Replacement Rubber Tips.

Specifications of the Extra Long Kickdown Door Holder:

  • Total Length: 7-3/4"
  • Arm Length: 7"
  • Maximum Door Gap to Floor: 5-1/2"
  • Rubber Tip: Gray
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Packaged with Mounting Screws

Sold Individually



*Item Discontinued

*Item Discontinued: use 7 Inch Kickdown Door Stop
